subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- November 09, 2026
body:
**AcreetionOS Newsletter - November 09, 2026**

**Exciting Update: AcreetionOS Now Supports Wayland as Default Desktop Environment!**

We're thrilled to announce that our community has made significant progress in making Wayland the default desktop environment for AcreetionOS. This update is the result of the tireless efforts of our community members, particularly cobra3282000, who has been working on Calamares-config-wayland to ensure a seamless transition. With this change, users can now enjoy a more modern and secure desktop experience.

**Community News**

* The Asahi Linux developers have released a new progress report on their efforts to create a Linux distribution for Apple devices. You can read more about it in the latest Asahi Linux 7.3 progress report.
* The X.Org Developers Conference (XDC) 2026 has concluded, and videos from the event are now available on YouTube. Catch up on the latest developments in the world of open-source graphics and display drivers.
* Amutable Foundations: A Technical Overview has been published, providing an in-depth look at the technical aspects of this innovative project.

**Practical Tip:**

Did you know that you can easily restore the window position on Linux using the firefox-fix package? Simply install the package from our repository, and you'll be able to restore your window positions as you switch between applications. This feature is especially useful for users who frequently switch between multiple windows and workspaces.

**Stay up-to-date with the latest developments in the AcreetionOS community by following us on social media:**

* Twitter: @AcreetionOS
* Discord: discord.acreetionos.org
* GitHub: github.com/AcreetionOS-Code
* GitLab: gitlab.acreetionos.org

Thank you for being part of the AcreetionOS community! We're always here to help and support you in your Linux journey.
